questions.question: In a certain code language, NAMELY is coded as 74 and MANAGE is coded as 45. How will MUSHER be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99fc7420a23237787baa0dd63b85ba6fae16b15bb95444f7f9cc2114572a7d37.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

**Sum of the positional values of the letters + 4**

NAMELY → N (14) + A (1) + M (13) + E (5) + L (12) + Y (25) + 4 = 14 + 1 + 13 + 5 + 12 + 25 + 4 = 74 

MANAGE → M (13) + A (1) + N (14) + A (1) + G (7) + E (5) + 4 = 13 + 1 + 14 + 1 + 7 + 5 + 4 = 45 

Similarly,

MUSHER → M (13) + U (21) + S (19) + H (8) + E (5) + R (18) + 4 = 13 + 21 + 19 + 8 + 5 + 18 + 4 = 88

Hence, ‘**88**’ is the correct answer.

'BIRD' will be coded as '64'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'YACHT' is coded as '8' and 'SHALEOD' is coded as '24'. How will 'ANALYSTIC' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (Number of the letters within the word - 4) × 8 

So,

 
• 'YACHT' is coded as '8'

Number of the letters in the given word is '5' i.e Y, A, C, H and T.

⇒ (5 - 4) × 8

⇒ 1 × 8

⇒ 8

And,

 
• 'SHALEOD' is coded as '24'

Number of the letters in the given word is '7' i.e S, H, A, L, E, O and D.

⇒ (7 - 4) × 8

⇒ 3 × 8

​⇒ 24

​Similarly,

 
• 'ANALYSTIC' is coded as :

Number of the letters in the given word is '9' i.e A, N, A, L, Y, S, T, I and C.

⇒ (9 - 4) × 8

⇒ 5 × 8

​⇒** 40**

​Hence, "40" is the correct answer.
